meta.name: review-codex
meta.description: This skill should be invoked by a review orchestrator (e.g. `reviewer:self-review`) to run a parallel self-review inside a Codex thread for an independent second opinion on the same scope.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让代码改动获得另一份独立评审意见
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在 Codex 中开发并希望代码合入前获得第二意见。
copy.tagline_en: Run a parallel self-review to get an independent second opinion on your code.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Codex and want a second opinion before merging code.

howto.what: 调用后会把自查任务转交给 Codex 线程，让它独立再跑一遍同一范围的审查，只出报告不直接改代码；若 Codex 内没有相应工具，则改用 codex:review 单遍审查并转换为同一报告格式。
howto.when: 当名为 `reviewer:self-review` 的审查编排器调用该技能，或用户直接使用 `reviewer-extras:review-codex` 命令（可带文件路径、目录或 `--diff <ref>` 参数）时触发。

say.note: 把 src/ 的自查任务分派给 Codex 独立复核
对比 main 分支的改动，让 Codex 给出独立审查报告
无参数时审查当前未提交的改动

howto.what_en: On invocation, dispatches the self-review task to a Codex thread so Codex runs its own parallel review of the same scope, returning a report only (no fixes). If Codex lacks the reviewer, falls back to a single-pass codex:review and converts its findings into the same framework.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a review orchestrator such as reviewer:self-review invokes this skill, or when the user runs the reviewer-extras:review-codex command with optional file/directory/--diff arguments (defaults to the current diff).

say_en.note: Dispatches self-review of src/ to Codex.
Compares changes against main and returns an independent report.
